facts.fact: NADRA says it handed the Civil Registration Management and Vital Statistics (CRMVS) System over to the Government of Somalia on 30 November 2024, with no rollout to offices stated.

States no ID number given at birth.
States who operates or maintains the ID system; only that NADRA developed and deployed it.
States no register keyed on the ID number.
NIMS is said to be deployed in 2023 but not that it issues unique credentials.

facts.fact: NADRA says the CRMVS System, part of the Somalia National Identification System project with MOIFAR, is financed through a grant from the Government of Pakistan.
